selection_reason: RLE compressed data -> bounds validation -> prevents buffer overrun during decompression
source_summary: c->rleoffset and c->rlelength come from SGI image file RLE tables (starttab and lengthtab arrays) populated from file data. c->bufsize is the file size minus SGI header size.
sink_summary: The unchecked values would be used in expandrow/expandrow2 functions as source pointers and lengths for RLE decompression operations.
guard_summary: The added check prevents buffer overrun by validating that rleoffset + rlelength does not exceed the allocated buffer size. If violated, sets error code and returns early.
risk_pattern: Bounds check added to prevent reading beyond allocated buffer during RLE decompression of SGI image data.
enclosing_conditions: Loop over image rows (c->rowno) and channels (c->channo)
context_summary: The check is added in the main decompression loop to validate RLE table entries before they are used to access the compressed data buffer.
unresolved_facts: Whether the RLE table values (starttab/lengthtab) are validated for consistency before this check
Whether there are other potential overflow paths in the decompression functions

hypotheses.fit_reason: Direct match: File-controlled RLE offset/length used in decompression without bounds check would cause reading beyond allocated buffer

hypotheses.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
hypotheses.fit_reason: Broader category: Memory operations (RLE decompression) access outside buffer boundary due to missing bounds validation
Potential mechanism: Bounds check logic could have off-by-one issues, though evidence shows comprehensive '>' comparison

hypotheses.cwe_name: Improper Handling of Highly Compressed Data (Data Amplification)
hypotheses.fit_reason: Related context: RLE decompression of file data without proper validation could lead to amplification attacks
